title: Ending a defence gives a real answer

captions.energy: Returning to the answer actually needed

meaning: You can end a repetitive defensive account and give an actual answer while preserving gentle steadiness before an uncomfortable clarification.
text: Death in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in ending a repetitive defensive account. The Chariot in energy supports a wish to return conversation to the answer needed rather than lose it in explaining the same thing again. Strength in emotions brings gentle inward steadiness. You can recognise an exhausted form and turn to the question’s substance without sharply ending the exchange or requiring every feeling to be settled already.

For example, you explain at length why a return call was impossible although the question now concerns whether you want to talk. You stop repeating circumstances and answer the present request. **A real answer can appear after a defence ends**. You can say how much time is available and hear whether it suits you both. Gentle steadiness helps withstand remaining dissatisfaction without another defensive circle. Yet returning to the present does not cancel an earlier expectation that genuinely existed and may have mattered.

Harshness appears if ending the defence prohibits mentioning everything that preceded it. Conversational direction then becomes a demand to move on immediately. The Chariot’s constructive direction helps distinguish the present question from another remaining response. You can answer clearly now and hear feeling without returning to endless justification; steadiness requires neither accounting for every minute nor declaring an earlier expectation insignificant to either of you.
